headline: Swiss Investment Group to Acquire New Zealand Ferry Operator StraitNZ
summary: A Swiss investment firm is set to buy StraitNZ, the operator of Bluebridge Cook Strait ferries, from Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners, which acquired the business in 2022.
why: StraitNZ provides freight and passenger shipping links connecting New Zealand's North and South Islands.

impacts.name: StraitNZ
impacts.why: Ownership transition to a Swiss investor shifts governance of the New Zealand ferry operator.
